name: seesaw_seated
text: Sitting astride a seesaw seat, holding the low handle in both hands with elbows pointing down. The knees bend as the seat lowers and the legs extend as the seat rises. Gentle seated rocking.

scene.description: Start at playground_seesaw.post_seesaw facing the model standing marker direction. A person sits astride a seesaw. Both thighs spread sideways around the narrow beam, knees point outward and shins hang outside its sides. Both hands remain on the horizontal grip ahead of the waist, elbows down. Keep the torso upright as the beam rocks gently; remain sitting astride, never stand or bring the knees together. Hips touches the physical model marker hip_left at 0.00s, 4.00s. LeftHand touches the physical model marker grip_left_left at 0.00s, 4.00s. RightHand touches the physical model marker grip_left_right at 0.00s, 4.00s. Both hands grasp the horizontal handle. Thighs and shins stay on opposite sides of the beam and clear the seat; keep the head clear of the handle.
